01_power_mcu/J2.notes: 8.5mm female socket; verify HAT standoff and Pi 5 clearance in PCB/mechanical layout.

01_power_mcu/U7.notes: HUSB238A-BB001-QN16R in QFN-16 (3x3mm). VDD powered by 3V3; default 5V startup, I2C programmable (0x42) from 5V to 20V with PPS support.

01_power_mcu/R14.notes: 47k 1% 0603 series gate resistor between GATE and EN_DRV.

01_power_mcu/R73.notes: 1.2k 1% 0603 sets U9 TPS259470 eFuse current limit to 2.78A typ (2.53A min), above U2 2.20A IPROPI limit.

01_power_mcu/C18.notes: 1uF 16V 0603 X5R ceramic bypass for HUSB238A VDD.

01_power_mcu/C73.notes: 1uF50V X7R10% replaces unavailable1.8uF. Attachment worst case reduces by0.88uF; verify controller startup with total bypass.
